ExpenseReport.description: An expense report that groups the expenses submitted by a user.

fields.name: ReportId
fields.description: Report identifier (auto-generated).

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: Id of the user who owns the report.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Human-readable report title.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Workflow status, e.g. Draft, Submitted, Approved, Rejected.

fields.name: SubmittedAt
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the report was submitted (null while Draft).

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the report was created.

Expense.description: A single expense line item extracted from a receipt or invoice image. The receipt image is stored in blob storage and referenced by ReceiptBlobKey.

fields.name: ExpenseId
fields.description: Expense identifier (auto-generated).

fields.name: ReportId
fields.description: Id of the parent ExpenseReport.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: Id of the user who incurred the expense.

fields.name: Vendor
fields.description: Merchant or vendor name from the receipt.

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: Total amount of the expense.

fields.name: Currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR, USD.

fields.name: ExpenseDate
fields.description: Date printed on the receipt.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Expense category, e.g. Meals, Travel, Lodging.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Free-text description or notes.

fields.name: ReceiptBlobKey
fields.description: Stable blob key of the receipt image in blob storage (not a URL).

fields.name: ReceiptSha256
fields.description: SHA-256 hash of the receipt image for integrity/dedup.

fields.name: ReceiptBytes
fields.description: Size of the receipt image in bytes.

fields.name: ReceiptMime
fields.description: MIME type of the receipt image, e.g. image/jpeg.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the expense record was created.
